reviews.text: My experience was simply incredible. We discovered that Astolfo had a lot of hair in his stomach and had lost weight. The doctor was very attentive, explained everything to me, we did the tests, started the treatment, and especially received management tips and general advice for rabbits that I had never heard of before, and she dispelled several myths. It was incredible. Now we just have to hope he gets better 🙌🏼
Excellent service from Dr. Rodrigo, who has extensive knowledge of psittacines, with perfect handling and great explanations for the bird's feeding and daily care.
Dr. Rodrigo was excellent! Very attentive and professional! The blood collection was incredible, very quick! Dr. Sândara provided full support during the consultation! I recommend him!!

A perfect 1000 for ExotiCare. The service was very informative and provided excellent guidance about the animal, and the correct handling for administering medication was perfect. In short, I left the clinic with a great impression. They showed great care and dedication. Congratulations!

I highly recommend them! They take exceptional care of my chinchillas 💗 They explained the post-operative care perfectly, and even provided tips to improve their daily lives. They truly care and treat the animals with affection, I am eternally grateful. …
Excellent service, specialized knowledge of wildlife, lots of affection for the animals; they treated my twister rat very well and gave him many tips to improve his quality of life.

I highly recommend the clinic! I took my rabbit and my two cockatiels there. Dr. Sandara and Dr. Rodrigo are wonderful, caring, always up-to-date, and have impressive technical knowledge!
For 2 years I searched for a clinic to have my rabbit spayed, until I found this clinic and I can say that I trust them a lot, not only for performing the spaying, but for the guidance on animal handling. I can say with certainty that today my pets are much healthier, happier, and much closer to me!

If you have an exotic pet, you can rest assured: ExotiCare is a truly well-prepared clinic. I highly recommend it; the service was exceptional!

I am the owner of a red-eared slider turtle, and before coming to the clinic, I went to other veterinarians in my area who were unable to properly assess her case or advise on the appropriate care. In total, there were 3 visits to chain clinics, and all of them were terrible! This caused the problem to last longer than it should have.

I decided to go to ExotiCare, even though it was in another city, and I can say with complete certainty: it was COMPLETELY worth it.

I was seen by Dr. Sandara, who was very careful with me and Gaia, my pet. The consultation was extremely thorough and detailed. She examined my turtle very carefully, truly assessed the clinical picture, and explained absolutely everything to me with great attention and patience. It was the first time I felt that my animal was truly being examined.

Furthermore, I arrived with a delicate situation, as my turtle had ingested plastic, and she guided me very confidently, immediately ordering the necessary tests and explaining all the next steps. I left the consultation with much more knowledge, peace of mind, and, most importantly, a clear care plan. One point that made a big difference for me was knowing that Dr. Sandara also has turtles at home. You can see that she's not just a technician; she's someone who truly understands and cares.

I also want to leave a message for other pet owners: if you have an exotic animal, look for a specialized clinic. It makes all the difference. The level of service, knowledge, and care is completely different.

Exoticare and Dr. Sandara were a game-changer in the care of my turtle. Thank you so much!!!
